decisions.reason: The building digital twin draws on the firm's geospatial integration and research knowledge, but its BIM base is newer and it had no website mention in 2024, which raises the risk of withdrawal.
Identity delegation is close to the firm's security components and is easy to maintain, though it may well be folded into the broader identity service.
The open GIS application framework is central to the firm's open, extensible component strategy, and its in-house development and research capacity let it evolve the framework steadily.
The identity service for GIS applications builds directly on the firm's platform integration know-how and was actively promoted, so it fits ongoing development.
The consulting workshop applies the firm's long experience with geodata processes, costs little to offer, and has its own dedicated page.
